# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: YEAR COPYRIGHT-HOLDER

# Runs on pull_request so a worker can open the pull request early.
# The first run can be the red run. A later push on the same pull request
# can be the green run. See docs/governance/GOVERNANCE_LINUS.md section 10.
# The required check name is ci.job_name in .governance/project.json.
#
# Each run is evidence for one commit. This workflow does not cancel a run.
# A cancelled run cannot be the red run of a regression test.
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  gate:
    name: gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Check out the head commit of the pull request, not the merge commit.
      # The run is then evidence for the exact head SHA.
      # The scope step needs the full history to find the base commit.
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: gatecheck
        run: python3 tools/gatecheck/gatecheck.py

      - name: test
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/gatecheck -v

      - name: spdx
        run: python3 tools/gatecheck/gatecheck.py --spdx-only

      # Head SHA, fresh base, packet scope, protected paths, and planned tests.
      - name: scope
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: python3 tools/gatecheck/gatecheck.py --pr
